topic: Someone discovers their neighbor is secretly wealthy
text: Well, I should've known better. Scope out the joint before getting cozy, that's the rule. But Alice, she was different. Seemed genuine, the way she lent a hand, a smile that didn't ask for anything back. Found out today she's swimming in dough—money she don’t flaunt, just tucked away, like a secret stash. Funny how things turn. Here I am, feeling the weight of every cup of coffee, every borrowed tool, things I thought were neighborly exchanges. Now, I wonder what part of her smile was real. Should’ve been more careful, kept a sharper eye. But sometimes, the hard edge of the city gets a little too close, and you start to let your guard down. Not again. Not ever.
